title: Cabinet approves GMRC GIFT City-Shahpur metro and ₹7,500 Cr POWERGRID equity cap
summary: GMRC metro extension approved; POWERGRID CPSE equity investment threshold raised from ₹5,000 Cr to ₹7,500 Cr per subsidiary; Srinagar Airport civil enclave ₹1,677 Cr.
